scope.new_reads: Existing run metadata, published navigation rows, and aggregate evaluation JSON only.

conclusions_zh: 原IMU增量支撑和数据可用时刻修正有直接守恒与来源语义依据，不以导航误差下降定义其正确性。
旧04的足式大幅航向收益不可作为平台贡献保留：相同后端在修正共享IMU输入后，U0已经从25.7165°降至4.09535°，而U1从3.76578°变为3.93243°。
修正后U1对U0只体现本短窗的小幅航向与位置差异，同时存在启动求解完成度差异；不能将该差异全部归因于足式信息量。
05 U0仅1/4初始seed达到一阶条件，3个仍未求完；05 U1四个均达到一阶条件，但合并为一个局部mode，仍未认证全局方向覆盖。
U1尚未超过同物理有限窗口的冻结V3：yaw、水平及3D位置RMSE均更大。V3为长时运行裁窗，当前为96秒冷启动，因此这是系统层对照，不是同后端消融或正式普适优劣结论。
05的终值加计偏置范数并未减小：U0 0.72109→0.83520 m/s²，U1 0.72668→0.74222 m/s²；ba与Rᵀg共同显著改变，剩余共享动态模型问题仍未解决。
加计偏置与重力投影必须共同解释；这些在线条件状态并非统一batch后验，相邻估计变化不能直接视为真实传感器偏置随机游走。
05输出保留IMU可用延迟，评价仍按测量时刻对齐；原GNSS接收延迟未建模。参考与GNSS同源，速度精度未评价。

initialization.seed_status_note: Per-seed status=NO_INIT is the pre-acceptance qualification record; use solver_converged/gradient and the accepted initialization status, not this field alone.
initialization.convergence_note: Budget exhaustion alone does not imply nonconvergence: a seed reaching the iteration cap can meet the projected-gradient first-order criterion; finite seeds never establish global directional coverage.

conditional_state_summary.statistical_scope: All 190 finite published measurement-epoch rows, 100.19799995422363–106 s. These are successive causal conditional estimates, not one joint batch posterior; no state is imputed over NO_INIT.
conditional_state_summary.averaging_policy: Trapezoidal mean and piecewise-linear squared-value integration over actual measurement timestamps; components body FRD.

evaluation.metric_policy: time-weighted RMSE of piecewise-linear squared errors; identical physical intervals; no interval crosses a joint NO_INIT row
evaluation.initialization_difference: joint starts at requested run start; frozen V3 is the original 66--340 s causal run, not restarted at this short window
evaluation.reference_claim: Fixposition-derived fused reference with shared GNSS lineage; not independent truth
